View detailed installation steps for MID Server setup.
Learn how to install, configure and troubleshoot your MID Servers.

Instance-issued certificates offer stronger, hassle-free security over the basic authentication your MID Servers are using. Certificates are issued per-server, rotate automatically, and eliminate password management. Learn more.

• Stronger security: Each MID server identity is mapped to a unique certificate
  • Zero maintenance: Certificates rotate automatically with no password resets
  • Your choice: Migrate everything at once, or test with a few servers

value.message: Select MID Server user to generate key

Select the MID Server user to generate a registration key for that user. 
Add this key into config.xml to register or re-register a MID Server. 
This key can only be used once and expires in 24 hours.

If you only need a ServiceNow-issued token for an expired cert or if you want to set up a new MID manually without going through the flow:

  • Select the MID Server user to generate a registration key for that user. 
  • Replace these properties in your config.xml to register or re-register a MID Server.
  • This key can only be used once and expires in 24 hours.
